# Codes

Coded values the core data uses (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE). Packs use the same values where they mean the same thing.

- **ClaimStatus**: RECEIVED, PENDED, DENIED, PAID, ADJUSTED, REPROCESSED
- **ClaimType**: PROFESSIONAL, FACILITY, PHARMACY
- **NetworkStatus**: IN, OON, OON_EMERGENCY
- **DenialCategory**: MED_NECESSITY, CODING, DUPLICATE, TIMELY_FILING, COB, NON_COVERED, MISSING_INFO, AUTH
- **AppealStatus**: OPEN, IN_REVIEW, DECIDED
- **AppealOutcome**: UPHELD, OVERTURNED
- **AuthStatus**: SUBMITTED, IN_REVIEW, PENDED_INFO, APPROVED, PARTIAL, DENIED, WITHDRAWN
- **AuthLineStatus**: APPROVED, MODIFIED, DENIED
- **ServiceType**: OUTPATIENT, INPATIENT, DME, HOME_HEALTH, SNF, PHARMACY, BH
- **Lob**: MEDICARE_ADV, COMMERCIAL, MEDICAID_MCO
- **EnrollmentStatus**: ACTIVE, TERMED, PENDING
- **PcpAssignmentStatus**: ACTIVE, ENDED
- **GeoType**: URBAN, SUBURBAN, RURAL
- **ProviderType**: PCP, SPECIALIST, FACILITY
- **ProviderStatus**: ACTIVE, TERMED, SUSPENDED
- **ProviderRole**: PCP, SPECIALIST, HOSPITAL, POSTACUTE, PHARMACY
- **FacilityType**: HOSPITAL, SNF, HOME_HEALTH, PHARMACY
- **ParticipationStatus**: PARTICIPATING, NON_PARTICIPATING, PENDING_ONBOARDING, TERMED
- **PanelStatus**: OPEN, LIMITED, CLOSED

## API error codes

Generic pack endpoints use MEMBER_NOT_FOUND, SCOPE_NOT_AUTHORIZED, CAREGIVER_NOT_VERIFIED,
CONSENT_EXPIRED, RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND and INVALID_PARAMETER automatically.

- INVALID_CLIENT (401)
- INVALID_TOKEN (401)
- VERIFICATION_FAILED (403)
- SCOPE_NOT_AUTHORIZED (403)
- CAREGIVER_NOT_VERIFIED (403)
- CONSENT_EXPIRED (403)
- MEMBER_NOT_FOUND (404)
- CLAIM_NOT_FOUND (404)
- AUTH_NOT_FOUND (404)
- APPEAL_NOT_FOUND (404)
- PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND (404)
- NO_COVERAGE (404)
- RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND (404)
- NO_ACTIVE_COVERAGE (409)
- NOT_PARTICIPATING (409)
- NOT_A_PCP (409)
- ALREADY_PCP (409)
- PANEL_CLOSED (409)
- OUTSIDE_ACCESS_STANDARD (409)
- SLOT_UNAVAILABLE (409)
- ALREADY_BOOKED (409)
- NOT_DENIED (409)
- NOT_APPEALABLE (409)
- APPEAL_EXISTS (409)
- DEADLINE_PASSED (409)
- DOCUMENT_NOT_REQUESTED (409)
- MEMBER_IDENTIFIERS_REQUIRED (422)
- LOCATION_REQUIRED (422)
- UNKNOWN_SPECIALTY (422)
- INVALID_PARAMETER (422)
- RATE_LIMITED (429)
- MINIMUM_NECESSARY (429)
- INJECTED_FAULT (503)
